verdict.rationale: Proton Pass is a documented SaaS product with a CLI, so agent-readable documentation is a fair axis to judge it on. Direct probes returned HTTP 404 for both https://proton.me/llms.txt and the markdown docs variant (pass.md). The CLI blog post is a different capability and is not agent-oriented documentation, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
